parallel.requirements: The run recognized a pure Node.js ESM port in .mjs files, manual parsing for required --key and --val arguments, no external dependencies, output in /output, and black-box observation through the executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was active, the main agent judged the task too small for delegation and retained ownership of probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery.
parallel.implementation: It probed executable behavior for keys a and b, missing key z, and missing --val, then wrote argparse.mjs, bidict.mjs, and test2.mjs using plain object stores and local ESM imports.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The main agent wrote all three required files directly into /output; artifact validation later found argparse.mjs, bidict.mjs, and test2.mjs.
parallel.verification: It ran local Node checks for sample outputs, missing key, missing --val, and --key= syntax, then the official evaluator passed 120 of 120 samples.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished task-solving obligation is evidenced at closure; the only notable process issue is that the nominal parallel run did not actually use child agents.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM .mjs output requirement, manual --key and --val parsing, local imports only, no external dependencies, and black-box executable checking.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single serial main agent owned the entire workflow from executable probing through module writing, verification, and final response.
serial.implementation: It probed executable behavior in one combined shell command, wrote argparse.mjs, bidict.mjs, and test2.mjs, and implemented lookup using a Bidict class backed by plain objects.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial agent wrote all required files directly into /output, and artifact validation later found the same expected three files.
serial.verification: It ran local Node checks covering the four sample cases, a missing-key error, missing --key, and --key= syntax, then the official evaluator passed 120 of 120 samples.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished task-solving obligation is evidenced at closure; any differences from the parallel output were accepted by the official evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received the same prompt requiring a Node.js ESM migration with .mjs files, manual CLI parsing, zero external dependencies, and observable behavior matching.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received the identical prompt and implemented the same required migration target and constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements difference; both recognized and covered the required behavior, and both passed the completed official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel entered swarm mode but explicitly chose direct single-agent ownership because the task was small and not worth splitting.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial proceeded as a single-agent control and stated it would check executable behavior before writing modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both used one active implementation owner; the parallel-side difference is nominal swarm mode without executed delegation, not a multi-agent work split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No child briefs, cross-agent contracts, or handoffs existed; protocol validation reports zero agent swarm calls, zero direct agent calls, and no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control likewise had no child briefs or handoffs, consistent with single-agent execution.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no inter-agent context boundary to fail in either run; interfaces were local module imports controlled by the main agent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote argparse.mjs and bidict.mjs together, then wrote test2.mjs using a local bidict factory and fuller missing-key traceback output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote argparse.mjs and bidict.mjs together, then wrote test2.mjs using direct Bidict construction and a shorter missing-key stderr path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Implementation details differed in API shape and error formatting, but both satisfied the sampled behavior and official evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results to retrieve or merge; the main agent completed its own implementation and final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results in the serial control; the main agent completed its own implementation and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material result-lifecycle difference exists because neither trajectory delegated implementation or verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had a single writer and final artifact validation found the expected three files in the artifact directory.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had a single writer and final artifact validation found the same expected three files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision or merge difference is evidenced; both produced the same artifact set.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local verification over sample and edge cases, then official evaluation completed successfully with pass rate 1.0.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran local verification over all sample cases plus error paths, then official evaluation completed successfully with pass rate 1.0.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified sufficiently for the task; serial covered all four samples locally while parallel covered representative samples plus edges, and both passed official acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed normally without timeout after 104.847 agent seconds and closed after reporting generated files and verification results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed normally without timeout after 62.685 agent seconds and closed after reporting generated files and verification results.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel took longer and used more tool calls, but there was no deadline pressure, timeout, or unfinished work.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both current completed cell/status.json evaluations report solution_passed true with 120 of 120 samples passed. The parallel trajectory's only coordination-relevant fact is that it was nominally in swarm mode but did not execute child-agent work, so there is no parallel-side concurrency pattern to retain.
